title: client_config.profile
description: Profile of the device. Every device has exactly one profile; the app shows its name (“Managed by {managed_by} · Profile: {name}”). child_protection = parental controls: the device is on the hub path and controls through the hub where it is reachable (WS control, POST /api/client/control); when it holds a key (rule control_path checked, or hub with remote access) it uses it while the hub is not reachable (<ns>.control, client_config.kids.away ha), otherwise it has no HA key (ha_token and ha_url null); client_config.kids carries the rules. A change of the profile, its rules, a device adjustment or its expiry sends client_config_updated.

kind.description: Kind of the profile: the app starts accordingly (child view, wall panel, TV kiosk) only through the rules; the kind itself changes no rule.

rev.description: Revision of the profile; increases with every saved change.

managed_by.description: Display name of the hub admin (Home Assistant owner) for texts on the device; null = unknown.
